George Nichols (actor) | George Nichols (October, 1864 – September 20, 1927) was an American actor and film director.  He appeared in 221 films between 1908 and 1928.  He also directed 103 films between 1911 and 1916.  He was born in Rockford, Illinois and died in Hollywood, California.  He, along with Henry "Pathe" Lehrman, became an arch-enemy of Charlie Chaplin, who would take direction from nobody while at Keystone.  'Pops' as he was known, was often cast as father to Mabel Normand.

Crone died shortly after completing the tasks, in June 1966.  Earlier in his career, he had been the original editor on "Citizen Kane", before being replaced by Robert Wise.

The Land Before Time | The Land Before Time is a 1988 American-Irish animated adventure drama film directed and produced by Don Bluth and executive produced by Steven Spielberg, George Lucas, Kathleen Kennedy, and Frank Marshall.

He assumed by Royal licence the surname of St George in lieu of his patronymic.  Before his elevation to the peerage Lord St George had represented Carrick in the Irish House of Commons.
